Metadata.title: Pathshala — Learn in your language
Metadata.description: Courses, quizzes and live classes in Bangla and English. Find what you want to learn, and teach what you already know.

Home.title: Learn in your language, at your own pace.
Home.lede: Courses, quizzes and live classes in one place. Find the subject you want to learn, and teach what you already know.
Home.step1Body: Programming, a language, office skills or exam preparation — start with what you actually need.
Home.step2Body: Lessons, quizzes and notes together. Stop anywhere and pick up from the same place.
Home.step3Body: Complete a course and get a verifiable certificate anyone can check from a link.

Courses.title: Courses
Courses.lede: Published courses will appear here, with filters for subject, language and level coming alongside them.
Courses.emptyBody: Instructors are preparing the first courses. They will show up here as soon as they are ready.

Footer.tagline: A place to learn and teach
